title: Drake And Adonis Stole The Show During The Raptors & Lakers Game [Watch]
htmlContent:
Drake was on duty on Wednesday, taking his adorable son Adonis to the basketball game between the Raptors vs. the Los Angeles Lakers in his home Toronto.

The 36-year-old hitmaker from Plan de Dieu was seen spending quality time with his little one - whom he shares with the French painter.

Sophie Brussaux, 33 - and even accompanied by winter leather jackets. The father and son duo had a blast and laughed it up together.

The self-proclaimed Certified Lover Boy completed his outfit with white trainers and wore his braided hair in rows of corn.

Meanwhile, his little mini-me wore a black leather jacket over a white top and black jeans.

Like his father, the bilingual boy dressed in white sneakers.

Drake is kicking off his holiday gift-giving a few weeks earlier this year. The 36-year-old star recently blessed BFB Da Packman with a pair of its NOCTA Air Force One. Drizzy attached a note beside the new shoes, encouraging BFB to continue his hard work.

“I hope you enjoy the gift,” Drake wrote. “Best of luck on your weight loss. Keep it up kid.” The Her Loss rapper simply singed the note, “The Boy.” BFB shared his excitement over the gift with a lengthy Instagram caption. “ONE OF THE GREATEST @champagnepapi SENT ME HIS SHOES,” BFB wrote. “AND GAVE ME MOTIVATION TO KEEP WORKING OUT. MAN THANKS SO MUCH. I STARTED FROM THE BOTTOM FR AND TO GET LOVE FROM ONE OF THE GREATS IS MAJOR.”
